name: hou_mcp_environment_complete
description: Check overall environment completeness by examining all pipeline stages: structure, zones, anchors, support, decoration, and atmosphere. Returns a completeness score and list of missing required elements.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment.environment_completeness import get_environment_completeness
from src.runtime.environment.environment_structure_builder import EnvironmentStructurePlan
from src.runtime.environment.environment_zone_builder import ZonePlan
from src.runtime.environment.anchor_asset_builder import AnchorPlan
from src.runtime.environment.support_asset_builder import SupportPlan
from src.runtime.environment.decorative_population import DecorationPlan
from src.runtime.environment.atmosphere_builder import AtmospherePlan
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Environment_Complete(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_environment_complete"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment_name", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("structure_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("zones_json",       "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("anchor_json",      "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("support_json",     "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("decoration_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("atmosphere_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("completeness_json",    "string")
        self.add_output("all_required_met",     "bool")
        self.add_output("completeness_score",   "float")
        self.add_output("missing_required_json","string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    def _parse(self, text, cls):
        if not (text or "").strip():
            return None
        try:
            return cls.from_dict(json.loads(text))
        except Exception:
            return None

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        env_name = (inputs.get("environment_name") or "").strip()

        try:
            structure_plan  = self._parse(inputs.get("structure_json"),  EnvironmentStructurePlan)
            zone_plan       = self._parse(inputs.get("zones_json"),       ZonePlan)
            anchor_plan     = self._parse(inputs.get("anchor_json"),      AnchorPlan)
            support_plan    = self._parse(inputs.get("support_json"),     SupportPlan)
            decoration_plan = self._parse(inputs.get("decoration_json"),  DecorationPlan)
            atmosphere_plan = self._parse(inputs.get("atmosphere_json"),  AtmospherePlan)

            checker = get_environment_completeness()
            result = checker.check(
                env_name,
                structure_plan=structure_plan,
                zone_plan=zone_plan,
                anchor_plan=anchor_plan,
                support_plan=support_plan,
                decoration_plan=decoration_plan,
                atmosphere_plan=atmosphere_plan,
            )

            met_str = "YES" if result.all_required_met else f"NO — missing: {result.missing_required}"
            self.log_info(f"Completeness '{env_name}': score={result.completeness_score:.2f}, {met_str}")

            return {
                "completeness_json":    json.dumps(result.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "all_required_met":     result.all_required_met,
                "completeness_score":   result.completeness_score,
                "missing_required_json": json.dumps(result.missing_required, default=str),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Completeness check failed: {exc}")
            return {"completeness_json": "{}", "all_required_met": False, "completeness_score": 0.0, "missing_required_json": "[]", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Environment_Complete
